module.description: Minecraft server management module with full lifecycle control

server_type.label: Server Type
server_type.description: Which server software runs this world. saba-chan can install every type. Spigot and CraftBukkit are built with the official BuildTools and take a few minutes; Pufferfish only has builds for some Minecraft versions.

java_path.label: Java Path
java_path.description: Path to Java executable (auto-detected if blank)

ram.label: Memory (RAM)
ram.description: Java heap size: a number with K, M or G (e.g. 4G, 1024M)

motd.label: MOTD
motd.description: Message shown under the server name in the server list

online_mode.label: Online Mode
online_mode.description: Only players with an authenticated Minecraft account can join (Mojang authentication)

view_distance.label: View Distance
view_distance.description: Maximum distance players can see (chunks). Higher values put more load on the server

simulation_distance.label: Simulation Distance
simulation_distance.description: Maximum distance in which mobs and crops are active (chunks). Higher values put more load on the server

spawn_protection.label: Spawn Protection
spawn_protection.description: Radius around spawn where non-op players cannot break or place blocks

level_seed.label: World Seed
level_seed.description: Seed for world generation (leave blank for random)

use_aikar_flags.label: Aikar's Flags
use_aikar_flags.description: Use the recommended Java options for smoother performance

managed_start.label: Managed Start (Console)
managed_start.description: Start the server through saba-runner so saba-chan can use its console. RCON stays off in every mode. If you turn this off, saba-chan cannot send commands to the server.

graceful_stop.label: Graceful Stop
graceful_stop.description: Send the 'stop' command and wait for the server to save and shut down. If you turn this off, saba-chan ends the server process at once.

enforce_whitelist.label: Enforce Whitelist
enforce_whitelist.description: Kick players not on whitelist when whitelist is reloaded

generate_structures.label: Generate Structures
generate_structures.description: Generate structures such as villages and mineshafts

accepts_transfers.label: Accepts Transfers
accepts_transfers.description: Allow connection transfer from other servers

broadcast_console_to_ops.label: Broadcast Console to Ops
broadcast_console_to_ops.description: Send console output to all online ops

broadcast_rcon_to_ops.label: Broadcast RCON to Ops
broadcast_rcon_to_ops.description: Send RCON command output to all online ops

enable_status.label: Enable Status
enable_status.description: Show server in multiplayer server list

enforce_secure_profile.label: Enforce Secure Profile
enforce_secure_profile.description: Require Mojang-signed public key for players

entity_broadcast_range_percentage.label: Entity Broadcast Range %
entity_broadcast_range_percentage.description: Distance at which mobs and other entities are sent to players, as a percentage of the default (10-1000)

force_gamemode.label: Force Game Mode
force_gamemode.description: Force default gamemode on player join

function_permission_level.label: Function Permission Level
function_permission_level.description: Default permission level for function commands (1-4)

generator_settings.label: Generator Settings
generator_settings.description: JSON settings for flat world generation

hide_online_players.label: Hide Online Players
hide_online_players.description: Hide player list from status response

max_chained_neighbor_updates.label: Max Chained Neighbor Updates
max_chained_neighbor_updates.description: Max consecutive neighbor updates before skipping (-1 for no limit)

max_tick_time.label: Max Tick Time
max_tick_time.description: Max milliseconds a tick can take before watchdog kills server (-1 to disable)

network_compression_threshold.label: Network Compression Threshold
network_compression_threshold.description: Minimum packet size to compress (-1 to disable, 0 to compress all)

player_idle_timeout.label: Player Idle Timeout
player_idle_timeout.description: Minutes before idle players are kicked (0 to disable)

pause_when_empty_seconds.label: Pause When Empty
pause_when_empty_seconds.description: Pause server ticking after no players for this many seconds (0 to disable)

debug.label: Debug
debug.description: Extra debug logging from the server

management_server_enabled.label: Management Server
management_server_enabled.description: Enable the server management protocol (JSON-RPC over WebSocket)

management_server_host.label: Management Server Host
management_server_host.description: Address the management server listens on

management_server_secret.label: Management Server Secret
management_server_secret.description: Secret used to connect to the management server

rate_limit.label: Rate Limit
rate_limit.description: Max packets per second before disconnect (0 to disable)

require_resource_pack.label: Require Resource Pack
require_resource_pack.description: Require players to accept the resource pack

resource_pack.label: Resource Pack URL
resource_pack.description: URL to a server resource pack

resource_pack_prompt.label: Resource Pack Prompt
resource_pack_prompt.description: Custom message shown when resource pack is offered

resource_pack_sha1.label: Resource Pack SHA-1
resource_pack_sha1.description: SHA-1 hash of the resource pack

server_ip.label: Server IP
server_ip.description: IP address the server listens on (leave blank for all)

status_heartbeat_interval.label: Status Heartbeat Interval
status_heartbeat_interval.description: Heartbeat interval for server status (0 to disable)

sync_chunk_writes.label: Sync Chunk Writes
sync_chunk_writes.description: Write chunk data to disk synchronously (more reliable, can be slower)

friends.label: Friends (small)
friends.description: Up to 10 players on normal difficulty

say.label: Announce
say.description: Send a message to all players

give.label: Give Item
give.description: Give an item to a player

save-off.label: Pause Autosave
save-off.description: Stop the server from saving the world automatically

save-on.label: Resume Autosave
save-on.description: Let the server save the world automatically again

kick.label: Kick Player
kick.description: Kick a player from the server

ban.label: Ban Player
ban.description: Ban a player from the server

errors.server_not_running: Server is not running. Please start the server first.
errors.timeout: Server response timed out. Please check the server status.
errors.server_type_mismatch: Server type is set to '{{chosen}}' but the server files are '{{detected}}'.
errors.server_type_install_unsupported: saba-chan cannot install '{{type}}' servers. Install it yourself and add it with 'Import existing server'.
errors.server_type_version_unavailable: '{{type}}' has no stable build for Minecraft {{version}} yet.
errors.installer_failed: The official '{{type}}' installer failed (exit code {{code}}). Please try again.
errors.installer_timeout: The official '{{type}}' installer took too long and was stopped. Please try again.
errors.installer_no_server: The '{{type}}' installer finished but produced no server files.
errors.server_jar_not_specified: server_jar not specified in instance configuration. Please add the path to server.jar
errors.server_jar_not_found: Server jar not found: {{path}}. Please check the path in instance settings.
errors.not_a_server_folder: This folder does not look like a Minecraft server folder (no server.properties or eula.txt), so nothing was deleted: {{path}}
errors.unsafe_world_name: The world name (level-name) "{{name}}" does not point to a world folder inside the server folder, or it matches a file the reset keeps, so nothing was deleted. Fix level-name in server.properties and try again.
errors.server_reset_partial: Some items could not be deleted: {{errors}}

detect.java_not_found: Java is not installed or not found in PATH
detect.java_version_too_old: Java {{current}} is too old. Minecraft requires Java {{required}} or newer.
detect.eula_not_accepted: Minecraft EULA has not been accepted
detect.port_in_use: Port {{port}} is already in use by another application
detect.out_of_memory: Insufficient memory. Java ran out of heap space
detect.world_corrupt: World data appears to be corrupted
detect.invalid_jar: The server jar file is invalid or corrupt
detect.permission_denied: Permission denied. Cannot access required files
detect.server_overloaded: Server is overloaded and cannot keep up with game updates

solutions.server_type_mismatch: Update (reinstall) the server, or set the server type to match the actual server.
solutions.java_not_found: Install Java 17+ (recommended: Adoptium Temurin) from https://adoptium.net/ and ensure it's in your PATH, or set the Java path in instance settings.
solutions.java_version_too_old: Install Java {{required}}+ from https://adoptium.net/. Current Minecraft versions require modern Java.
solutions.server_jar_not_specified: Set the path to your server.jar in instance settings.
solutions.server_jar_not_found: Download the official Minecraft server from https://www.minecraft.net/download/server or check the path in settings.
solutions.eula_not_accepted: Accept the Minecraft EULA by clicking 'Accept EULA' in server settings, or manually set eula=true in eula.txt.
solutions.port_in_use: Port {{port}} is already in use. Stop the other application or change the server port in settings.
solutions.out_of_memory: Increase the RAM allocation in server settings (e.g. 4G or 8G), or close other applications to free memory.
solutions.world_corrupt: Restore the world from a backup, or delete the world folder to generate a new one. Deleting it erases the old world.
solutions.invalid_jar: Re-download the server jar from the official source. The current file may be incomplete or corrupted.
solutions.permission_denied: Run saba-chan as administrator, or change file permissions to allow read/write access.
solutions.working_dir_error: Create the directory manually or choose a different location with write permissions.
solutions.server_overloaded: Reduce View Distance and Simulation Distance, lower Max Players, or allocate more RAM.

errors.java_executable_missing: Java was extracted but the java executable was not found
errors.java_run_failed: Java was extracted but failed to run
errors.java_release_unavailable: No pinned Java {{version}}+ JRE is available for this PC ({{platform}}). Set the Java path in the instance settings.
errors.java_download_warning: Failed to download Java {{version}}: {{error}}. Please install Java {{version}} or later manually.
errors.version_info_unreadable: Could not read version info from the server jar
errors.version_no_server: Version {{version}} has no dedicated server download

messages.running_installer: Setting up Minecraft {{version}} with the official {{type}} installer (this can take a few minutes)
messages.server_starting_no_response: Process is running but server is not yet responding to queries
messages.properties_using_defaults: server.properties does not exist. Showing defaults

reset.label: Reset server
reset.description: Deletes what the server made: the world, settings, plugins, mods (including mod JARs), configs and logs. The server JAR, eula.txt, the bundled Java and other files in the folder are kept. If the server lives in the instance folder, logs are kept too.
